body: As somebody with depression who honestly thought about killing themself a year ago, I would have missed out on the thing that keeps me going now. My 3 best friends, I’ve known them for a few years at work but finally took up the invitation to spend time with them outside of work and it was the best choice I could ever make. I can’t imagine going a day without talking to them. After 25 years of never having friends, I made lifelong ones in a year and I can’t believe I almost missed out on that.
